test_title: PYST 20: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The tutor was not teaching the student.

options.text: The student was teaching the tutor.
The student was not taught by the tutor.
The student was not being taught by the tutor.
The student was not being teaching by the tutor.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The tutor was not teaching the student."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the student" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "was not teaching" to "was not being taught" (past continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the tutor."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The student was not being taught by the tutor."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The student was teaching the tutor." – This is an incorrect transformation of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: **"The student was not taught by the tutor." – This is not the correct form of the passive voice for past continuous tense.
 
• **Option 4: **"The student was not being teaching by the tutor." – Incorrect verb form usage.
